How we know

For visitors

Book on Rapha’s events site. The host calls it inclusive and no-drop, with a coffee stop. Rapha club members get ride insurance.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
The easiest pace the host lists is 18–23 km/h: relaxed, with time to talk. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Rapha Mallorca Easy Ride group ride

Rapha Mallorca Easy Ride is a road group ride in Palma, Spain. It rolls some Saturdays at 8:30 am local time from Rapha Mallorca clubhouse.

A no-drop Saturday ride from the Rapha clubhouse in Palma at an easy pace with a coffee stop, three Saturdays each month.
